subject: Re: Intermittent API failures during Black Friday load testing
messages:
From: Asha Verma <asha@lumenretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intermittent API failures during Black Friday load testing

Hi Priyom,

Quick heads-up — during our Black Friday load rehearsal this morning we saw repeated 500 errors and pronounced latency spikes when hitting your /v1/generate endpoint between 08:45 and 09:10 PST. Traffic pattern: ~1.2k concurrent requests, median latency spiked from ~180ms to 2.4s, and about 7% of requests returned 500. Our engineers captured traces and a short export (attached). This is blocking our go/no-go plan for the November launch.

Can you confirm root cause and whether Redwood will provide a remediation credit or trial extension given the impact to our validation and the fact we’re on a pilot plan? We need confirmation today so we can decide whether to proceed with the rollout later this week.

Attachments: incident_screenshots.png, request_export.log

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Verma
Head of Platform Reliability, Lumen Retail
asha@lumenretail.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Verma <asha@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent API failures during Black Friday load testing

Hi Asha — thanks for the report and for sending logs. We’re investigating immediately.

High level: we see the same error patterns in our telemetry (burst of upstream queue pressure causing transient 500s and high tail latency). Stephanie is pulling the postmortem and I’ll escalate to sales leadership for an expedited credit decision. Our priority is to get you back to a reliable test window today.

Immediate next steps:
- Stephanie will share a short technical summary to your eng inbox within 60 mins.
- I’ll follow up with a proposed goodwill remediation (credit + trial extension) and an internal approval path.

We appreciate the heads-up and sorry for the disruption — we’ll make this right.

Best,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent API failures during Black Friday load testing

Priyom / Steph — reviewed the telemetry and customer impact. This was a capacity-related regression triggered by an unfortunate scheduling overlap on our dedicated shard pool; engineering has applied a hotfix and the shard has been isolated.

Authorization: Approve a one-time courtesy credit equal to $9,000 (covers estimated token overage and mitigation expenses for the pilot) plus a 21-day trial extension to give Lumen time to re-run their validation. Please post the credit to deal DL-4829 and confirm the expiration date for the extension.

Attached: approved_credit_note.pdf for the billing team. I’ll loop in finance if legal wants a formal amendment, but this should be sufficient to keep the project moving.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Verma <asha@lumenretail.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent API failures during Black Friday load testing

Hi Asha — thanks for your patience. Quick update and confirmation: 

- Root cause: transient shard capacity regression, hotfixed and isolated by engineering (summary attached by Stephanie in a separate thread).
- Credit: one-time service credit of $9,000 has been approved and applied to your account (Deal DL-4829). The credit will appear on your next invoice; billing reference note: "IR-20261120 remedial credit".
- Trial extension: we’ve added a 21-day extension to your pilot window, new expiration: 2026-12-14.

Attachments: approved_credit_note.pdf (billing reference).

Action items for you: please re-run your Black Friday rehearsal schedule and let us know if you want Redwood on the call for live support — we can assign an on-call engineer during your test window.

Apologies again for the disruption; I’ll keep monitoring and we’re standing by.

Best regards,
Priyom
